scripts.build: npm run check:routes && npm run check:permissions && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:mobile: npm run check:routes && npm run check:permissions && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode apk
scripts.build:apk: npm run check:routes && npm run check:permissions && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode apk
scripts.cap:sync: bash scripts/with_node22.sh npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:android: bash scripts/with_node22.sh npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: bash scripts/with_node22.sh npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:sync:emulator: CAP_ANDROID_SCHEME=http CAP_CLEARTEXT=true bash scripts/with_node22.sh npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:prepare:emulator: npm run build:apk:emulator && npm run cap:sync:emulator
scripts.ios:prepare: npm run build:mobile && npm run ios:assets && npm run cap:sync:ios
scripts.cap:open: bash scripts/with_node22.sh npx cap open android
scripts.cap:open:android: bash scripts/with_node22.sh npx cap open android
scripts.cap:open:ios: bash scripts/with_node22.sh npx cap open ios
